lines.en: label futabadorm25:
: Futaba, are you in there?
: Just a second, [futabamaster]!
scene black
I take a step back and wait for Futaba to finish getting ready.
I also hope that getting ready doesn't constitute anything out of the ordinary- because if she were to get dressed up for this, I'd feel at least a little bad for looking...entirely normal.
Not that I have anything else to wear in the first place, but yeah.
This is her first “date” ever, though, so who knows?
scene bookdateredux1
: Hey! I'm ready to go whenever you are.
Oh, good. Looks like I may have jumped the gun in worrying about her getting dressed up for this.
But...I should probably be a nice person and compliment her anyway. I think that's how this sort of thing is supposed to go.
: Hey, Futaba. You look nice.
scene bookdateredux2
: What? No...I look the same as always.
: I was...originally planning on wearing something else, but...I decided against it at the last second.
Ahh, so my hunch wasn't entirely off after all.
scene bookdateredux1
: But, umm...thank you anyway, Sensei...
: The sun still hasn’t set, so I figured we could walk there instead of taking the bus. Is that okay with you?
: I kind of figured that's what was going to happen anyway, so yeah.
scene bookdateredux2
: So...you're okay with that many people seeing us together?...Because I know you said it was fine if it was the book store, but walking around in public is-
: Futaba, stop being weird and just focus on enjoying yourself today. I really don't care who sees us walking around together. It's not a big deal.
scene bookdateredux3
: R-Right! Yeah! I'm sorry...I'm just a little nervous, I think...
: But if you're okay with me- Uhh...if you're okay with going, we can leave now...
: Good save, Futaba. Lead the way, I guess. I'm ready when you are.
scene black
scene bookdateredux4
: Hmm...It should be somewhere around here...at least based on the address my friend gave me.
: How long ago did this place open, exactly?
: A few weeks ago, I think? I’ve heard nothing but good things, though.
: And this friend of yours is reliable? You're sure we're not about to walk into some mugging or something?
scene bookdateredux5
: That would certainly be a strange plot twist, don't you think?
: Don't smile while acknowledging the probability of us being robbed. It's improper date behavior.
: I'm sure we'll be fine, Sensei. My friend is plenty reliable.
scene bookdateredux4
: But I guess it wouldn't hurt to check for their address online as well...
: Just in case she got her numbers mixed up.
: Worst case scenario, we get totally lost and do something else. There's a pretty good porn shop around here that I wouldn't mind taking you to.
scene bookdateredux6
: I'd...really rather not go some place like that...
: Would you prefer just...staying lost instead?
scene bookdateredux4
: I...don't think I'd be opposed.
: Getting lost in a...mostly random place with you...seems like it might be kind of fun.
: Sure. Except this isn't really a random place and we both have GPS apps on our phones. Actually being lost around here seems unlikely.
scene bookdateredux5
: Hahah...I guess that’s true.
: But...fortunately for both of us, it looks like we found the place after all.
scene black
I turn around to find a sign advertising the book store we've been on the hunt for as Futaba quickly rushes inside.
She's so excited that she forgets to even hold the door open for me- and under normal circumstances, I’d consider this incredibly rude.
But I know she doesn’t mean any harm by it today.
She’s just having a hard time containing herself.
Kind of like how I am whenever I see her in her pajamas.
But that's probably not a thing I should be having an inner monologue about when my date is running around inside of a book store.
scene joyoflife1
: Wow! Just look at everything, [futabamaster]!
: There’s even more than the library in here!
I wind up needing to follow Futaba up a staircase as she immediately climbs to the highest point of the bookstore.
She's not kidding when she says there's more in here than the library. This place feels like somewhere you can get lost in if you're not paying attention.
I’m actually pretty shocked, to say the least.
From the outside, this shop seemed relatively small.
But the inside is like a whole new world.
A world full of wonderful things.
At least by Futaba’s standards.
Me? I honestly couldn’t care less.
scene joyoflife2
: Isn’t this amazing? It’s even better than I dreamt it would be.
: You actually dreamt about a book store?
: Mhm! I dreamt that you and I would come here...and that there’d be millions of stories waiting to be cracked open.
: And that you’d pull one of the books from one of the shelves and start reading to me.
: Then, I'd rest my head on your shoulder and-
scene joyoflife3
: Actually, can you forget I told you about that dream? It started getting really embarrassing once I said it out loud.
: Done.
scene joyoflife4
: I mean...It’s not like I’d try to stop you if you did do something like that, though...Hahahah...
Futaba, overcome by what seems like sensory-overload, begins to forget how to filter her dialogue.
Her fingers pick at the wooden finish of the barrier in front of her as her eyes dart to the side and scan the rest of the store.
It’s like paradise to her.
And here she is, alone with the one person who can make her heart flutter even more than words can.
It’s not conceited to say that, is it?
scene joyoflife5
: Are you going to buy anything, [futabamaster]? Is there something in particular you’re looking for?
: I don’t think this place has one of those computers that more modern stores have where you can search the inventory for a particular book but-
: I’ve gotten really good at finding things from working in the library! And I can help you if you want!
: It’s fine. I’m just here to spend time with you.
scene joyoflife6
: Huh?
: Does that surprise you?
: A little bit, yeah...I figured you would probably buy at least one thing...
: And hearing you say this was all to spend time with me...made my heart skip a beat or two.
: That’s probably because you’re in love with me.
scene joyoflife7
: Keh-!
: Is that like, a new reflex for you or something?
scene joyoflife8
: Unfortunately, I think it is...
scene joyoflife5
: But...I guess you’re probably right. My heart does seem to be skipping a lot lately.
: I’m sure you have at least some part in that.
: Wow, who could have ever predicted this?
scene joyoflife9
: Heheh! I know, right?
: It’s almost like I can’t help but wear my heart on my sleeve around you or something...
A long pause follows Futaba’s innocent laughter.
Her fingers stop picking at the finish of the barrier and begin to tremble instead.
She takes a deep breath.
And then makes a horrible mistake.
scene joyoflife10
: I like you.
: I know you know that already. But I wanted to...finally say it out loud.
: You don’t have to say anything back...I’m not an idiot.
: I know how weird it is for a student to confess to her teacher...
: And I know you’re probably only spending time with me because I don’t say no to doing that kind of stuff with you...
: And...I’m honestly okay with that as long as it means that, at least every once in a while...we can do things like this together.
scene joyoflife11
: N-Not to say I don’t like doing all of that other stuff! It’s actually...really exciting...and...umm...
scene joyoflife12
: Ugh...What am I even saying right now?
: Futaba.
scene joyoflife13
: Y-Yeah?...
: I’m not just using you.
: You know that, right?
: You’re...not?
: No. How many times do I need to say that?
scene joyoflife14
: Ummm...
: A million?...
: I don’t think I have that kind of time...
scene joyoflife15
: I know, [futabamaster]...
: And I’m trying to understand...Really...
: I just never really expected someone as amazing as you to take the time to actually listen to me.
: I always think that my...feelings fall on deaf ears or that...I’ll be bothering someone if I open up to them.
scene joyoflife12
: And...while I admit that you’re a lot...umm...hornier than I thought you’d be...I still know that you listen.
: I’m sure there’s some sort of motive for it, whether it be l-l-liking me back or not, but...It’s still kind of hard to believe when I really think about it.
: And I feel like even if you did tell me a million times that's not the case...there’d be a voice in the back of my head saying, “Don’t do it, Futaba! It’s a trap!”
scene joyoflife15
: But...I’ve decided-
: Even if this is a trap...and you are just using me for weird stuff-
: I’m not.
: Right. But if you are...I’m fine with it.
: That’s just how much I like you.
I’m glad that this book store isn’t as crowded as I initially thought it would be.
Because, if it were, I’m sure there would be plenty of eyes on us right now.
But, being so high above the only other people in the store, no one can hear us.
Futaba’s confession has fallen on me and me only.
But it’s a twisted one with an unwarranted dark side to it.
Sure, I might be pursuing a number of girls right now, but it’s not like I feel absolutely nothing when it comes to this one.
I do like her. As much as I can.
I think.
I don’t know.
It’s gotten annoyingly hard to tell what I really think as of late.
But as the two of us stand amidst stacks and stacks of stories under the warm light of a temporary sanctuary-
There is one thing that rings true in my mind.
And, it’s that I can not accept this confession.
: Futaba.
: ...[futabamaster].
: I can’t reciprocate your love.
: Like I said, I’m okay with being-
: Yet.
scene joyoflife16
: What do you mean by ‘Yet?’
: I mean that it feels wrong standing next to you and hearing that you’re okay with me using you as long as the two of us go to a book store every once in a while.
: So...wait.
: I’m not sure what you’re saying. Do we need to stop...hanging out? Did I mess things up? Because-
: No. You didn't mess anything up.
: It’s just clear to me that your confidence isn’t where it needs to be yet.
: And until it is, no confession of yours can possibly stick.
scene joyoflife17
: But...
: But what if it never gets to where it needs to be?
: What if I can’t ever be happy with who I am?
: Then what?
: I stay on-hold forever?
: You won’t stay on hold forever. I’ll help you.
: How?
: I don’t know. But I’ll figure it out.
: That's part of my job, isn't it?
: You promise?
: I promise to try.
: So, can I try confessing again once my confidence gets a little better?
: If I do it again after that...will you actually take it seriously?
: You can try confessing whenever you want and I’ll listen each and every time.
: But you're right. I won't look at it seriously until I know for sure that you're not treating yourself like some sort of tool.
scene joyoflife18
: I like you...
: I already told you, I’m not-
: You told me I can confess whenever I want. So I did it again.
: Oh. Well, uhh...thanks?
: No, thank you.
: For everything...
scene joyoflife19
: But, umm...
Futaba pauses once again.
Her fingers go back to peeling paint off of the barrier.
: I guess we should probably start shopping now, huh?
: We’ve kinda...been up here for a while and I think the employees might think we’re up to something...
: Then lead the way. Like I said, I’m here to spend time with you. Go browse to your heart’s content and I'll just...silently follow you or something.
scene joyoflife20
: *Sniff* Okay!
: But please bear with me! This might take a while~
scene black
It did take a while.
Nearly two hours.
But they were two hours I wouldn’t trade for the world.
